problem_statement: Build a brand-new Wishlist page from scratch at the /wishlist route of this FASHION e-commerce storefront (Vite + React + react-router-dom v6 + Tailwind). The route does not exist yet — today /wishlist renders nothing. Construct the full page inside the site's existing storefront shell (top FASHION header + footer) and reuse the site's Tailwind design system (the secondaryBrown #8A8475 accent, the serif Merriweather type, the centered product-card treatment used on the Shop and Landing pages). The wishlist must present a heading 'Your Wishlist' with a short subtitle, a row of category filter buttons (All, plus the saved collections), and a responsive grid of saved product cards. Clicking a category filter must actually narrow the visible saved items and update the section heading and the saved-count — not just sit there. The page must also render without horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport.
required_content: The page sits inside the existing storefront shell (top FASHION header + footer), consistent with the Shop and Landing pages
A page heading 'Your Wishlist' (rendered as an <h1>) with a short descriptive subtitle line about the saved items being kept in one place
A horizontal category filter rail with an 'All' button plus one button per saved collection (Luxury Collection, Summer Edition, Unique Collection)
A section heading that reads 'All Saved Items' by default, alongside a saved-item count
A responsive grid of saved product cards, each reusing the site's card treatment (product image, title, formatted category, price, and a 'View product' link to the product page)

Clicking a category filter genuinely narrows the grid to only that collection's saved items and updates the same <h3> section heading text to the collection name (e.g. "Luxury Collection") and updates the count
The whole page fits a 390px mobile viewport with no horizontal scrolling
design_constraints: Mount the page inside the existing HomeLayout shell so the FASHION header and footer render, consistent with the other storefront pages
Reuse the Tailwind design tokens and utilities already in the template (the secondaryBrown #8A8475 accent, the serif body font, centered card typography, the bordered button treatment)
Reuse the existing formatCategoryName helper for displaying collection names
Do not introduce a new visual language or a second router/layout

Palette tokens to reuse: the secondaryBrown accent is #8A8475 (rgb(138,132,117)) on the filter buttons (white #ffffff button text); page/card backgrounds are white #ffffff; body copy in the dark near-black #372a26; all type is Merriweather serif
The 'Your Wishlist' title is an <h1>; the movable section heading ('All Saved Items' / the active collection name) is an <h3>; product-card titles are <h2>
author_notes: 方案A: baseline /wishlist 是空 route (element=<></>, 顶层注册于 HomeLayout 外; router 无 catch-all 故未匹配会出 react-router 默认 404 页, 故必须显式空 route); reference 完整实现 category filter (activeFilter state 驱动 visibleItems + heading + count); bad 将 filter 按钮 onClick 改为 no-op 且 visibleItems 写死为全部 (结构与默认 All Saved Items 面板正常渲染，但点 Luxury Collection 不会把 heading 换成 Luxury Collection). 三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。createBrowserRouter 无 basename，vite 无 base，故 state_plan path 为 /wishlist。filter 按钮带 data-filter 属性以避免文本选择器冲突。saved 数据内联 (json-server 在 capture 时不跑)。
